question: How is the twenty-ninth chapter on weapon mantras identified within the Merutantra?
premises: The text is approved by Mahamaya and Mahakala and composed by Shiva.
The section is named the description of weapon mantras.
inference: This colophon identifies the twenty-ninth chapter of the Merutantra as the description of weapon mantras.
plain_english: Thus, in the Merutantra composed by Shiva and approved by Shri Mahamaya and Mahakala, ends the twenty-ninth chapter named the description of weapon mantras.
